record.question: Which of the following is an important requirement when selecting a site for a community pharmacy?
options: The site should be spacious, airy and preferably in a secluded place.
The site should be close to the clinics of practicing physicians.
The site should always be in a big building with multiple floors.
The site should be on a government owned property.
record.explanation: Official final key: B — The site should be close to the clinics of practicing physicians.. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 10, printed Q77. Source limitation: The ranking is subjective and depends on local planning and regulation. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
